latest_release.body:
## Your Next Store - Storefront Template for LLMs v1.0.0 

This is the first stable release of the Your Next Store LLM-friendly template; an open-source, Stripe-native Next.js storefront built to work with AI coding tools.

- idiomatic Next.js App Router patterns; predictable for Claude, Codex, Cursor
- fully typed commerce APIs; fewer hallucinations, more correct code
- Stripe-native checkout; no plugins, no glue layers
- fast by default; Next.js 16, React Server Components, edge caching

This release is about stability, clarity, and making AI-assisted commerce development boring in the best way possible. Clone it, run it, and let the LLM do the heavy lifting - without inventing your data models.
